description: A single-panel scatter plot of interface mismatch values. The y-axis is labelled "Mismatch values (%)" with numbered ticks at 0, 6 and 12 (upper limit of the axis box about 14). The x-axis carries four discrete inclusion-interface categories, left to right: Al2O3/MnS, AlN/MnS, TiN/MnS and Al2O3/AlN. Two horizontal dashed lines divide the plot: a green dashed line at 6% and a red dashed line at 12%, creating three labelled bands — "Most effective zone" below 6%, "Moderate effective zone" between 6 and 12%, and "Invalid zone" above 12%. Four black square markers are plotted, one per x category; no numeric data labels are printed beside the markers. Visually all four markers lie between the 6% and 12% dashed lines, i.e. inside the moderate effective zone; the TiN/MnS and Al2O3/AlN markers sit highest, just below the 12% red line, while the Al2O3/MnS marker is the lowest. The citing text gives the mismatch degrees as 8.41%, 8.94%, 11.65% and 11.66% respectively, and argues that Al2O3, AlN and TiN can nucleate MnS while Al2O3 can also nucleate AlN. The caption additionally refers to Table 7, calculation results of mismatch degree between different inclusions, which is not part of the supplied image.

subfigures.description: Scatter plot of mismatch values (%) (y-axis, 0-12 with a green dashed line at 6 and a red dashed line at 12) versus four inclusion pairs on the x-axis: Al2O3/MnS, AlN/MnS, TiN/MnS, Al2O3/AlN. Background regions are labelled 'Most effective zone' (<6%), 'Moderate effective zone' (6-12%) and 'Invalid zone' (>12%). Four black square markers fall in the moderate effective zone; no values are printed on the markers.

observations.observation: The y-axis of the plot is labelled 'Mismatch values (%)' and is ticked at 0, 6 and 12.
The x-axis lists four inclusion interface pairs, left to right: Al2O3/MnS, AlN/MnS, TiN/MnS, Al2O3/AlN.
A green dashed horizontal line at 6% and a red dashed horizontal line at 12% divide the plot into three labelled bands: 'Most effective zone', 'Moderate effective zone' and 'Invalid zone'.
Four black square markers are plotted, one per x-axis category, and all four lie above the 6% green line and below the 12% red line, i.e. within the 'Moderate effective zone'.
The markers for TiN/MnS and Al2O3/AlN are the highest, positioned just below the 12% red dashed line, while the Al2O3/MnS marker is the lowest of the four.
No numeric values are printed next to the data markers; the marker heights can only be compared with the 0, 6 and 12 gridlines.

The caption titles the figure 'Calculation results of mismatch degree of composite inclusions' and also labels a 'Table 7. Calculation results of mismatch degree between different inclusions', which is not present in the supplied image.
The citing text states the mismatch degrees of Al2O3/MnS, AlN/MnS, TiN/MnS and Al2O3/AlN are 8.41%, 8.94%, 11.65% and 11.66%, respectively.
The citing text interprets the results as showing that Al2O3, AlN and TiN could provide nucleation sites for MnS, and that Al2O3 could also provide heterogeneous nucleation sites for AlN.
The citing text refers to lattice parameters of different inclusions in Table 6, which is not part of this figure group.
